description: Installation of 2no air conditioning units to the side of rear back addition at first floor level; installation of a retractable awning at the front elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- MR/PL-GF(Ex&Pr);
- MR/PL-(Pr Awn);
- MR/PL-PLAN(Pr AC);
- MR/PL-ELEV(Pr AC);
- Perfera (model no. FTXM-A / RXM-A) wall mounted air conditioning unit specifications received 6 April 2026.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - The external sound level emitted from the air condition units at the 
development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background 
sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact. The assessment 
shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected 
noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.
		
To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises are not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - Prior to first use, the air conditioning unit at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 
		
To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The awning hereby approved must not project or over-sail any part of the public highway, including the footway or carriageway.

To ensure that the development does not have an adverse impact on the operation of the public highway or on highway or pedestrian safety, in accordance with Policies T1 and T3 of the Local Plan (2018).
subdivision_of_building: Rear first floor wall, and ground floor front of building
